name: How long does it take to replace double hung windows in a typical home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace double hung windows in a typical home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for double hung window replacement depends on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the installation. For a standard home with 10-15 windows, installation can often be completed within one to three days. However, factors such as custom window orders, unforeseen structural issues, or extensive trim work can extend the timeline. Your project manager will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific home and project scope during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing double hung windows in a typical home usually takes 1-3 days for 10-15 windows. Project duration varies based on quantity, size, and complexity.
